python3 << 'EOF'
# Export-Import Bank Total Direct Sales (Sales column) for fiscal years 1963-1974
# From treasury_bulletin_1969_12_page_182.txt (1963-1969)
# From treasury_bulletin_1974_12_page_126.txt (1970-1974)

sales_data = {
    1963: 366,
    1964: 436,
    1965: 124,
    1966: 63,
    1967: 153,
    1968: 91,
    1969: 379,
    1970: 406,
    1971: 269,
    1972: 248,
    1973: 145,
    1974: 21
}

# Calculate median of period 1963-1974
sorted_values = sorted(sales_data.values())
print("Sorted values:", sorted_values)

# For 12 values, median is average of 6th and 7th values (positions 5 and 6 in 0-indexed)
median = (sorted_values[5] + sorted_values[6]) / 2
print(f"Median (average of {sorted_values[5]} and {sorted_values[6]}): {median}")

# Signed deviation for 1974
value_1974 = sales_data[1974]
deviation = value_1974 - median

print(f"\n1974 value: {value_1974}")
print(f"Median (1963-1974): {median}")
print(f"Signed deviation (1974 - median): {deviation}")
print(f"Rounded to 1 decimal place: {round(deviation, 1)}")
EOF
